name: The Doll
source:
Can a person create an ideal shell for the soul? This is the question that Albert Faunston asking during his life of inventor, he dedicated his youth to the creation of mechanical dolls.
Due to circumstances, he has to leave his home and realize his dream.

The novel is based on the book of one of the authors of this novel, this part of the story will tell you about prologue taking place in the book, introduce the past of the main character of the original - Kishita, tell about the fate of the girl and reveal the mystery of her appearance.
translation:
一个人能否为灵魂创造一个理想的外壳？这是阿尔伯特·法恩斯顿（Albert Faunston）在他的发明家一生中提出的问题，他将自己的青春奉献给了机械玩偶的创造。
由于环境的原因，他不得不离开家乡去实现自己的梦想。

小说根据原作作者之一的原著改编，这部分故事将为你讲述书中发生的序幕，介绍原作主角岸田的过去，讲述女孩的命运并揭开她的出现之谜。
